thread:
Asha Nair: Quick ask 1 Orchid Labs renewal next week. Need a concise SLA packet: 30d + 90d uptime, p95 (primary) + p99 (appendix), short incident bullets, fallback use, and a worked credits example. Can eng + cs owners assemble? :calendar:

Ben Cole: I can grab metrics. Which service & regions? Also confirm whether Dedicated windows are excluded. 

Asha Nair: Service = orchid-serve-text. Regions: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 secondary. Yes, Dedicated reserved windows excluded per contract. 

Rory Kim: I'll pull data and drop CSV + screenshots. Plan: 
```bash
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/summary?service=orchid-serve-text&period=30d,90d&group=region" | jq .
```
Dropping to /shared/reports/orchid/2934000123. 

Priya Desai: I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph and an FAQ: "When do credits apply?" Keep tone simple. 

LegalBot: Legal snippet: "Credits calculated pro-rata against monthly committed spend; issuance requires Redwood validation and applied as billing adjustment on the next invoice." (contract OR-2026-11). 

Rory Kim: Uploaded metrics.csv and grafana_shots.zip. Quick summary: us-west-2 uptime_30d=99.918%, uptime_90d=99.943%; us-east-1 uptime_90d=99.997%; p95_us-west-2=240ms; p99_us-west-2=610ms; fallback_count_90d=5. 

Ben Cole: Draft credit example: monthly commit = $40,000. Tiers (customer-specific): >=99.95% no credit; 99.9-99.95 => 4% credit; 99.0-99.9 => 10% credit. Using us-west-2 30d = 99.918% -> falls in 99.0-99.9 => 10% credit = $4,000 (regional). Show weighted global example too. :white_check_mark: 

Asha Nair: Timeline: internal review Wed 3pm PT, customer-ready packet Thu EOD. Please ping when CSV, slides, legal blurb, and one-pager are in the folder. Thanks team! :pray: 

Rory Kim: All items uploaded. 

Priya Desai: Draft one-pager + FAQ uploaded. 

Ben Cole: I'll compute weighted uptime and add worked math to the slides. 

Asha Nair: Excellent. Ill review Wed morning and consolidate for renewals. If blockers surface call them out here. :thumbsup:
